scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “A radial continuum phase transition with algebraic decay” (preprints/A-radial-continuum-phase-transition-with-algebraic-decay-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 228 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d53cafa68c322a07), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a bounded continuous function ϕ : [0, ∞) → R and finite constants B, C > 0 such that X i<j ϕ(|xi − xj|) ≥ −BN, |ϕ(r)| ≤ Cr−3−1/32 (r ≥ 1). There are an open interval I ⊂ (0, ∞) centered at 5p/3 and a common inverse temperature βc ∈ [7/8, 9/8] such that, for every ρ ∈ I, the canonical free energy f(β, ρ) = − lim L→∞ 1 βL3 log Zϕ L,⌊ρL3⌋(β) exists and is finite for every β > 0. Its finite one-sided derivatives at βc satisfy f′ −(βc, ρ) > f′ +(βc, ρ). In particular, f( · , ρ) is not differentiable at βc.
